beats.name: Noise
beats.text: Every AI model starts out as noise.
beats.picture: The model draws on as a box of dials; every needle swings to a random setting.

beats.name: Guess
beats.text: Ask it a question, and it guesses.
beats.picture: A prompt slides in on the left, an arrow feeds the model, and a flat list of unsure guesses pops out on the right.

beats.name: Wrong
beats.text: Training measures how wrong that guess is,
beats.picture: The guesses collapse into one red number, the loss, which becomes a dot sitting high on a curve.

beats.name: Downhill
beats.text: and nudges every number inside the model a little, downhill.
beats.picture: The dot steps down the curve; with every step the dials turn a little and the loss falls.

beats.name: Code
beats.text: In code, that whole idea is four lines.
beats.picture: Cut to an editor: the four lines of a training loop arrive one by one.

beats.name: Loop
beats.text: Run them a few thousand times,
beats.picture: A highlight cycles through the four lines while a step counter runs to 5,000 and the loss readout falls.

beats.name: Works
beats.text: and the noise turns into something that knows the answer.
beats.picture: Back to the model: its dials are settled, the same prompt goes in, and one tall bar answers: Paris.
